text: The penalty for voluntarily stabbing someone, i.e., causing injuries without intent to kill, is twenty years’ imprisonment, and if the act was pre‑meditated the punishment is life imprisonment (article 208). This applies only when the blows or injuries are intentional and not aimed at causing death; the harsher life sentence is triggered specifically by premeditation.

draft.text: If a person voluntarily stabs another causing injury without premeditation and is not a descendant or spouse of the victim, the punishment is one year of imprisonment and a fine of one thousand dinars.
If the stabbing is premeditated, the punishment is three years of imprisonment and a fine of three thousand dinars.
If the attacker is a descendant or the spouse of the victim, the punishment is two years of imprisonment and a fine of two thousand dinars.
If the stabbing results in mutilation, loss of use of a member, disfigurement, permanent infirmity or incapacity up to twenty percent, the punishment is five years of imprisonment.
If the stabbing results in an incapacity exceeding twenty percent, the punishment is ten years of imprisonment.
If the stabbing causes such severe injury and the attacker is a descendant of the victim, the punishment is twelve years of imprisonment.
If the stabbing causes the victim’s death without intent to kill, the punishment is twenty years of imprisonment.
If the stabbing causes the victim’s death and was premeditated, the punishment is life imprisonment.
